input.name: Stillwater KPU-T128
input.notes:
Mid-range KPU SKU. M0.5 inverse-scaling: T128 keeps 32x32 PE arrays for
more total PEs (131K) than T256's 20x20 layout (102K). 70/20/10 tile
mix. Targets autonomous robots, advanced edge AI applications. TSMC N16,
12W default with 6W and 18W profiles.
